basic_info.description: Enjoy the city living in this light-filled 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom home with an open floor plan, modern kitchen, and floor-to-ceiling windows in the living room. The gourmet kitchen overlooks the living room and features stainless steel Bosch appliances, Quartzite stone countertops, and beautiful white oak cabinetry. The spacious master bedroom is carpeted, and the master bath includes stone tiles, shower stall, and soaking tub. In-unit washer/dryer, and wine storage are included.    Relax in style on Millennium Tower's 20,000 sq. ft. Club Level: a wine cellar and tasting room, private fitness center, screening room, lap pool, outdoor terrace and an owners' lounge / dining room, and 24 hour doorman and concierge. ** Some photos have been virtually staged. **
